searchText: expanded on my position here as well now: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/thoughts-on-pqai-hegota-and-focil/30421/6?u=caspar but this would arguably be double counting if listed again now I think it's fair to add since we are anyway not using this list to infer the direction we're leaning. not sure I see the diff between keep and conditional, reading Jihoon's article makes it pretty clear it's a keep take, also ethlabs' take is pretty much unified so I would either have individual takes or ethlabs (with the different links) as on bullet point, not both ah no, jihoons one was more a separate section (related work) - not counting as unconditional. I wasn't reading it as a hegota opinion piece but more as a helpful resource for the discussion right, I think the closing is hinting at it being conditional but no need to nit DEFER means postponed? I'm for postponing. FOCIL looks ok on the EL side on the first look, but the friction surface is substantial if you check the details. The Erigon team shares my opinion. My ethresearch article tried to focus on providing technical details, so putting it under related work makes sense to me. I've posted my opinion to ethmag: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/a-better-pipeline-toward-pq-and-censorship-resistant-ethereum/30522 yeah defer == postponing I think it would be great to either voice that in acd or write it down, either your own take or erigon's. I presume something like a short doc by clients might be needed anyway. postponing means DFIing to be clear, I don't think there is a need to soften it right, but i think it's clear that I don't mean "postponing the decision" or something ah no but I mean postponing FOCIL is somewhat confusing, the decision is really keeping it in or DFIing it not like a commitment to include it later or whatever That was actually my question, but I asked it wrongly. DFI it is.
